subject: Renewal: OptimaMed resilience add-on (DR cluster + tenant isolation) and term recast
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@optimamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@optimamed.com>, procurement@optimamed.com
Date: 2026-11-01 09:12 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion — DR footprint + tenant-level isolation

Ben — thanks for the renewal notice. We reviewed our usage and want to propose two additions for next term: a dedicated DR cluster in a secondary VPC for failover, and tenant-level isolation for our analytics workspace (PHI workloads).

Primary asks:
- Add a second private cluster with warm standby capacity (target peak burst 12 GPU-equivalents).
- Tenant carve-out for analytics env with KMS integration and separate logging retention.
- We'd like to align the pricing over a 24-month term with a phased payment schedule.

Tom from IT and procurement are CC'd. Can you share an updated SOW and rough price impact? We are sensitive to lead time — target cutover Q1 2027.

Thanks,
Sarah
VP Product, OptimaMed
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@optimamed.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@optimamed.com>, procurement@optimamed.com
Date: 2026-11-01 11:04 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — DR footprint + tenant-level isolation

Sarah — thanks, this is clear and reasonable. High-level response: we can provision a warm-standby DR cluster in a separate VPC and implement tenant-level isolation for the analytics env with KMS-backed keys and separate audit streams.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I'll pull together an updated quote + SOW (incl. cutover timeline and lead times for the on-prem appliance if needed).
2) Loop in our solutions engineering for the isolation design so we can confirm migration impact.
3) If procurement prefers, we can present a 24-month amortized price and staged milestone payments.

I'll get a draft to you by EOD Friday.

Ben
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(p) 415-555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 08:07 -0800
Subject: Fwd: OptimaMed renewal — architecture and pricing help needed

Team — quick sync. OptimaMed (OPTM-3342) wants: warm standby DR in separate VPC + tenant-level isolation for PHI analytics. Target cutover Q1 2027 and wants a 24-month term. Attachments: their high-level diagram (isolation-architecture-diagram.png) and our current renewal quote (OPT-3342-quote-v1.pdf).

Questions: 
- Monica: recommended pricing uplift for warm-standby cluster (12 GPU equiv) + isolation engineering hours?
- Karthik: any red flags for KMS / audit separation and lead times for integrated logging retention changes?
- Kimberly: legal/finance — are there term recast constraints for adding standby clusters mid-renewal vs. at renewal effective date?

Please reply with notes — want to have an internal position before I send the SOW.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 10:33 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: OptimaMed renewal — architecture and pricing help needed

Ben — quick numbers from SE side: 
- Warm-standby DR (12 GPU-eq): list uplift roughly 42% of their existing dedicated footprint annualized, ~includes reserved capacity + warm standby licensing. With 24-month term we can offer 16% term discount.
- Isolation engineering: estimate 40–60 engineer-hours (design, validation, cutover runbook) unless they want on-prem appliances — add 20–30 hours.
- Ops lead time: 6–8 weeks for VPC provisioning + security reviews; additional 3–4 weeks if they require HSM/KMS integration and audit stream segregation.

I'll attach a more detailed cost breakdown to the draft quote.

Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 11:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: OptimaMed renewal — architecture and pricing help needed

Notes on compliance/ops: 
- KMS: we can integrate with their KMS but will need SAML/SCIM for service principal onboarding; expect 2–3 weeks to exchange IAM config and test keys. HSM customer-managed option adds procurement lead time but OK.
- Logging/audit separation: we create per-tenant log buckets and separate retention policies; this is low risk but requires updated IAM and logging pipeline configs.
- Cutover approach: recommend canary in a shadow VPC, smoke tests, and a final cutover window. Minimal downtime if planned.

No blockers from infra — timeline aligns with Monica's estimates.

Karthik
Director, Platform Reliability Engineering
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@optimamed.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@optimamed.com>, procurement@optimamed.com
Date: 2026-11-09 16:47 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal: OptimaMed resilience add-on (DR cluster + tenant isolation) and term recast

Sarah — attaching an updated quote and a draft MOU capturing the additions (OPT-3342-quote-v2.pdf, MOU-draft.docx) and a high-level isolation diagram. Key summary:
- Proposed term: 24 months starting 2027-01-15.
- Add: warm-standby DR cluster (12 GPU-eq) — annualized uplift + 16% term discount.
- Add: tenant-level isolation for analytics env with KMS integration, separate log retention, and an agreed cutover runbook.
- Deliverables & timeline: provisioning and security review (6–8 weeks), KMS onboarding (2–3 weeks concurrent), cutover planning + canary (2 weeks). Target go-live: 2027-03-01.

Action items for OptimaMed: please confirm the payment schedule preference (monthly vs. milestone-based), and if procurement wants the MOU routed to your legal team we can send a redline-ready DocuSign link.

Attachments: OPT-3342-quote-v2.pdf (pdf), isolation-architecture-diagram.png (image), MOU-draft.docx (docx)

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Cell: 415-555-0192

--
